lcc_original: 拉麥生挪亞之後，又活了五百九十五年，這期間還生兒養女。
notes: LCC replaces UNV's 並且 with 這期間還 — both are unannotated Chinese connective/temporal additions with no Hebrew equivalent; SNs transfer cleanly to 生兒養女 regardless
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew direct object marker ʾet, same as UNV
Number sequence 五百九十五年 is identical in both versions; dual WH08141 placement (after 百 and after 年) preserved to reflect Hebrew construct שְׁנַת in the compound numeral
